notes.title: Build Master is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641118/dd4d6e4f62583f9742f06bbee96ac3b24bb811ab.jpg[/img]

Greetings, fellow colonists!

The moment we've all been waiting for is nearly here – we're coming to Steam! Together, we'll bring Mars to life, turning it into a realm where dreams become reality and ambitions soar among the stars.

But we can't embark on this thrilling journey without your support! By adding Build Master: Marsville to your Steam wishlist, you're not just expressing your excitement; you're becoming an integral part of our extraordinary expedition. Let's take the first step together, and may our Martian Odyssey be remembered for generations to come!

Furthermore, we'll keep you updated on our progress, share mesmerizing artwork, and unveil intriguing game content. Stay tuned for the remarkable voyage that lies ahead!
